{{Otheruses|River}}
'''Nihun River''' was a river on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brosi]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. It flowed into [[Nomers Ocean]] through [[Shoengen Delta]]. Nihun River also crossed [[Delta 1]], [[Delta 2]] and [[Forest Valley]], going near [[Nihun Valley]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

Nihun River was within the sphere of influence of the [[Brosin Underground]] around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="AIR" />
